description: The second false positive in the identity rule, and the reason it matches frames rather than stems. A first pass matched the bare stems identif* and recogni*, so "a recognisable braided loaf, with her hands dusted in flour" was refused because an adjective and a pronoun shared a sentence. What identifies somebody is "recognisable as", not "recognisable".
